dialogues.speaker: Wangshu Inn Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Wangshu Inn Bulletin Board, providing notices of all recent happenings big and small. If guests have any suggestions, requests, or other thoughts, please feel free to post them here as well.

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "I sometimes catch a glimpse of a youth standing on top floor, but I've never seen this person before around the inn. Could it be my imagination?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Our inn is situated in the Dihua Marsh, a region of mist and mysticism. What's strange about seeing a good omen here? We thank guests for their understanding.
